payload.title: a names-only claude stanza misreports act events as unfired
payload.body: Observed at 2a51381c: where the host's claude stanza was written by a deploy before act bindings (native names, no acts), cratylus eventTap install --events operator.consult.pre skips the event with 'Claude Code fires no native event for it', exit 0. Claude Code does fire it (PreToolUse on AskUserQuestion); what is missing is the stanza's binding, and the deploy that writes it (cratylus install --harness claude, or cratylus deploy --harness claude) goes unnamed. The command line's rule that every error says what went wrong and what to do is not met on that path.
